LinkedIn quietly published a research paper on arXiv that explains their entire new algorithm (360 Brew). It's called GPU-RAR (Retrieval as Ranking), and it's built on Meta's LLaMA-3 model fine-tuned on LinkedIn's own engagement data.

IN THIS VIDEO I BREAK DOWN:
 How your profile now becomes a literal AI prompt 
 Why dwell time matters more than likes or comments 
 The data proving smaller accounts can outperform larger ones 
 Why engagement pods, hashtag stuffing, and timing hacks are dead 
 What LinkedIn SEO means now (and why it matters for AI visibility) 
 The tactics that actually move the needle in 2026

I also share a real client example where we broke every LinkedIn formatting "rule" and hit 85,000 impressions. The new algorithm doesn't reward following rules. It rewards understanding your audience.
